top_signals.title: Republicans see Trump’s unceasing Iran war as midterm threat
top_signals.summary: The continuing hostilities have demoralized GOP voters, who sent Trump to the White House in order to tame inflation and keep the U.S. out of overseas conflicts.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Guggenheim Ties Weigh on Acrisure Debt, Dragging High-Yield Credit Markets
top_signals.summary: It had already been a tough 2026 for Acrisure. Part fintech, part insurance broker, the firm said in late May it would cut 11% of its workforce, or some 2,250 people, as part of a sweeping overhaul to modernize operations. Some of its bonds and loans had fallen, but still remained above levels typically deemed distressed.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Stellar tokenized RWA market more than quadruples to nearly $4B
top_signals.summary: Stellar’s real-world asset market has expanded rapidly this year as institutional adoption and tokenization activity grow across the network.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.
